# The Account Hub overlay guard returns before shortcut interception

The owned shortcut callback now returns when tabmail.globalOverlay is true, before preventDefault, stopPropagation and shortcut dispatch. Account Hub sets that flag before opening its modal and clears it on close. The fixed source retains the guard in the later ShortcutsOverlay module, with additional window/repeat handling. This covers the selected interceptor rather than every keyboard route. The new negative test always sends Ctrl+2, while its positive helper uses Alt+2 on Windows, so it does not directly cover that Windows Spaces combination. No keyboard or test ran.

Scope: Mail shortcut routing and Account Hub modality.
